lead: Nara Chandrababu Naidu is an Indian politician, born on 20 April 1950 in Naravari Palle.
As of 2026, he is 76 years old, and his birth date places him under the Taurus sign.
He has held the office of Chief Minister of Andhra Pradesh and Member of the Andhra Pradesh Legislative Assembly.
The sections that follow break down Nara Chandrababu Naidu's biography into quick facts, early life, career history, personal life and a year-by-year timeline.

sections.heading: Nara Chandrababu Naidu — Career and Professional Work
paras: His professional record lists politician as his main occupation.

He has held the following offices: Chief Minister of Andhra Pradesh (2014–2019), Member of the Andhra Pradesh Legislative Assembly (1989–present), Chief Minister of Andhra Pradesh (1995–2004), Member of the 16th Andhra Pradesh Legislative Assembly (2024–present), Member of the 15th Andhra Pradesh Legislative Assembly (2014–2019) and Member of the 16th Andhra Pradesh Legislative Assembly (2024–present). He is affiliated with Telugu Desam Party.

He has taken part in World Economic Forum Annual Meeting 2015, World Economic Forum Annual Meeting 2016, World Economic Forum Annual Meeting 2017, World Economic Forum Annual Meeting 2018 and World Economic Forum Annual Meeting 2019.
